records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Vantage Ventures!
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no project, no invite, no milestone despite welcome email [email:ab2e9217] and a held onboarding call [calendar:c8a87b97]; no customer replies or tickets signal low engagement, though the attended call leaves some chance of self-start in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: Following up on your Wrenfield getting started call
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks for making time for the getting started call last week. I wanted to check in as you get Vantage Ventures set up.

A good first step is creating your first project: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready to bring the team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
